vcmi.wiki.glossary.aom-atlantean.town.de:
{Atlantis} (aom-atlantean) is the town of the Atlanteans from Age of Mythology. Its troops, heroes and town revolve around three mechanics: the {Three Aspects}, {Favor} and the {Ages}.

## The Three Aspects
The troops of every dwelling have three forms, each belonging to one Aspect: {Sky}, {Time} or {Earth}. Every hero serves one patron god, and under his command the Aspect of that god is one step stronger.

| Aspect | Patron god | Troops of this Aspect | Patron bonus |
|------|------|------|------|
| Sky | Oranos | Attacks mark the target with the {Sky Eye} for 2 rounds: Aspect troops hit it with no range or wall penalty and +1 Luck | Sky Eye lasts 3 rounds |
| Time | Kronos | Attacks add a stack of {Time Lag} (-1 Speed); at 3 stacks the target is {Timelocked} for a round | Timelock at 2 stacks |
| Earth | Gaia | Leave {Lush Ground} under their feet for 3 rounds at the start of each round | Lush Ground heals 15% |

- {Time Lag}: a hit that deals less than 3% of the target's total Hit Points adds no stack; after a Timelock ends, the target cannot receive Time Lag for 2 rounds.
- {Lush Ground}: friendly troops standing on it heal 10% this round, get +2 Defense and cannot be affected by Time Lag or Timelock; enemies standing on it get -2 Speed this round.
- {Sky and Time}: when the target bears both the Sky Eye and Time Lag, attacks ignore 30% of its Defense.
- {Hero forms} (Murmillo Hero, Arcus Hero) belong to none of the three Aspects: they deal +100% damage to targets bearing the Sky Eye, add one more stack to targets bearing Time Lag, and get +3 Attack while standing on Lush Ground. When an army has Sky, Time, Earth and a hero form all together, the hero form can attack one more time in one round, once per battle.

| Level | Sky | Time | Earth |
|------|------|------|------|
| 1 | Murmillo | Dimachaerus | Orichalcum Guard |
| 2 | Winged Longbowman | Volley Archer | Arcus |
| 3 | Automaton Warrior | Iron Automaton | Bronze Automaton |
| 4 | White-Plume Lancer | Caladria | Green-Plume Seer |
| 5 | Trident Nereid | Tiger Shark Nereid | Nereid |
| 6 | Starlit Centimanus | Unbound Centimanus | Centimanus |
| 7 | Lava Titan | Sickle Titan | Moss Titan |

### The Titan Cycle
In battle one Aspect is {ascendant} each round, in the order Sky, Time, Earth. Ascendant troops get +2 Speed and +15% damage that round.

[![Triune Order](aom/atlantean/skills/aomSeasonCommand_basic_82.png)](wiki:skill/aom-atlantean:aomSeasonCommand)

- The racial skill {Triune Order} raises the ascendant damage bonus to 30%, 45% and 60% and gives the hero +1, +2 and +3 Attack; from Advanced on, the cycle starts from the Aspect of the hero's patron god.
- The town building {Patron Temple}: in sieges the cycle starts from the Aspect of the defending hero's patron god.
- The specialty of the hero Kronos keeps Time ascendant for two rounds in a row.
- The combination artifact {Titan Legacy}: a further +10% ascendant damage, and all three Aspects are ascendant in the first round.

## Favor
The specialty of seven heroes - Leto, Atlas the Skybearer, Krios, Hyperion, Helios, Oceanus and Kastor - is {Favor}: they gain 1 Favor at the start of each round and receive a boon at 2, 4 and 7 Favor, each once per battle and triggered automatically.

| Favor | Boon |
|------|------|
| 2 | The specialty troops gain {Divinity} for 2 rounds: attacks ignore 15% of the target's Defense |
| 4 | Differs by hero, see below |
| 7 | By patron god: Kronos gives all enemy troops +1 stack of Time Lag; Oranos gives all enemy troops -2 Speed for 2 rounds; Gaia grows Lush Ground under all friendly troops |

The boon at 4 Favor: Leto repairs her specialty troops to full Hit Points; Atlas the Skybearer makes his specialty troops take 50% less damage this round; Krios lets his specialty troops attack one more time this round; Hyperion fully charges his specialty troops at once; Helios gives his specialty troops +25% damage for 2 rounds; Oceanus restores 20% Hit Points to all friendly living troops; Kastor gives his specialty troops +4 Attack and Defense for 2 rounds.

Each boon is received once per battle. When the specialty troops are not on the field, the first two boons go to the friendly stack with the highest total Hit Points.

## God Powers
The Mage Guild of Atlantis holds 12 additional {god powers}:

- Level 2: [Shockwave](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomShockwave), [Deconstruction](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomDeconstruct), [Valor](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomValor), [Gaia Forest](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomGaiaForest)
- Level 3: [Carnivora Seed](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomCarnivoraSeed), [Spider Lair](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomSpiderLair), [Hesperides](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomHesperides), [Vortex](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomVortex)
- Level 4: [Traitor](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomTraitor), [Chaos](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomChaos), [Tartarian Gate](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomTartarianGate)
- Level 5: [Implode](wiki:spell/aom-atlantean:aomImplode)

{Affinity}: when a hero casts a god power of his own patron god, its damage, healing and summoned amount are increased by 25%, lasting powers last one more round, and Vortex moves one more stack. The last line of every god power's description says which patron gods have affinity with it.

[![Divine Echo](aom/atlantean/skills/aomEcho_basic_82.png)](wiki:skill/aom-atlantean:aomEcho)

The racial skill {Divine Echo} gives god powers a 30%, 45% and 60% chance to echo: the same power takes effect once more on a random target, at half strength and at no Spell Point cost. The Sorcery synergy and the Grail building {Nine-Ring Canal Capital} each add another 10%; towns in the Mythic Age or Wonder Age also add 10% in sieges.

## Ages
Once all the buildings of an age are built, the town enters that age automatically. The effects of a later age replace those of the earlier one; they do not add up. Before the first age is reached the town is in the {Archaic Age}, which gives no bonus; right-click the current age in the town hall to see which buildings the next age needs.

| Age | Buildings needed | Creature growth (per week) | Other |
|------|------|------|------|
| Classical Age | Tavern, Fort, Marketplace, Gladiator School, Archery Range | Level 1-2 +2 | None |
| Heroic Age | Town Hall, Mage Guild Level 2, Citadel, Blacksmith, Machine Workshop, Bird Sanctuary | Level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +1 | Stack experience +20% |
| Mythic Age | City Hall, Mage Guild Level 3, Castle, Patron Temple, Nereid Grotto, Centimanus Prison | Level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +2 | Stack experience +20%; Divine Echo +10% in sieges |
| Wonder Age | Capitol, Mage Guild Level 5, Sky Passage, Resource Silo, Titan Gate | Level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +2, level 5-6 +1 | Stack experience +20%; Divine Echo +10% in sieges, garrison Hit Points +10% |

The +20% stack experience applies to all your troops and is counted once, however many towns you own.

## Return to Atlantis
Once the Grail building {Nine-Ring Canal Capital} is built, heroes of the Atlantean classes who visit the town learn the special spell {Return to Atlantis}. It is a level 5 spell that never appears in the Mage Guild, and heroes of other factions' classes cannot learn it.

When it is cast in battle, waves sweep across the whole battlefield and the city of nine rings rises in golden light; a stack of random out-of-town myth units drops in on your side at once, and another stack follows at the start of every round until the battle ends. The total Hit Points of each stack are Spell Power x 20 (Basic), x 30 (Advanced) or x 40 (Expert), at least 1 creature; if a summoned stack of the same kind is already on the field, the newcomers join it. It can be cast only once per battle and does not trigger Divine Echo.

15 kinds of creatures can come: Prometheans, Lava Prometheans, Lesser Prometheans, Stymphalian Birds, Tartarian Spawn, Arguses, Sea Servants, Wild Satyrs, Gold-Horn Satyrs, Hamadryads, Lampades, Star Lampades, Men o' War, Carnivoras and Ironclad Behemoths.

## Other
The commander {Chief Oracle} marches with Atlantean heroes. The war machine {Cheiroballista} is sold at the town's Blacksmith. The combination artifact {Titan Legacy} is fused from 7 components.

With the submod "Coastal Land Terrain" enabled, the native terrain of Atlantis becomes {Coastal Land}.
